product.name: Monoprice 6ft 16AWG 3-Outlet Polarized NEMA 1-15 Indoor Extension Cord 13A/1625W White
product.description: This 6‑foot 3‑outlet indoor extension cord allows you to plug up to 3 devices into a single power outlet. It features a polarized NEMA® 1‑15 plug one one end and three polarized NEMA 1‑15 receptacles at the other end. The polarized NEMA 1‑15 design features a larger blade on one side, ensuring that proper polarity is maintained at all times.The receptacle end features a cover for unused receptacles, ensuring that little hands cannot insert items into the live outlets. This UL® listed extension cord features two 16 AWG stranded copper conductors and is rated for up to 13 amps/1625 watts of power at 125 VAC.Important: This extension cord is intended for indoor use only.
